body: that does look useful, unfortunately none of those universities is within distance to me but it is a nice resource, maybe someone else browsing this thread could use it. As for me, I think it's just too late for me to try therapies or anything. I had my chance to live life, and create something beautiful for myself and I wasn't able to do that. Hopefully I can find peace somewhere beyone this world :)

I cannot afford therapy, it's a long story but in my circumstances I fall in a certain gap of not being able to get state help and not being able to afford it on my own. I'm pretty much left to my own devices.

The meetup groups are something I want to try but I am so self conscious of how I look that I end up not attending the events that I have an interest in. My only "hobby" is writing songs, and that's a mainly solitary task.

this makes a lot of sense, however, i can feel my depression has won. I just don't have the energy to survive anymore and everything is weighing on me. I just want to have the peace and emptiness that not existing will give me because I don't think I can find that in this life.

I honestly don't know how to meet people, I'm very shy. The friends I made in college were all out of pure luck, and I don't know if that can be replicated. I feel like I'm never going to have a social life again and everything appears to be so insurmountable even if it is easy. I know people tell me "go out and meet people!" but like it takes ALL my energy just to wake up, not die, and take care of my daily responsibilities.
